parent_objective: audit whether M1362 alpha 0.1 should replace M1154 as the official public base
blocked_by: M1369 classifies M1362 alpha 0.1 as a public-base promotion-audit candidate
supersedes: using M1362 alpha 0.1 informally as base without promotion audit
starting PPO from M1362 alpha 0.1 before promotion audit
claiming private or source-rich paper evidence from public promotion gate

public_gates: M1370 must audit M1369 exact, proof, source-diverse, generalization, and behavior tiers
M1370 must state whether M1362 alpha 0.1 becomes the official public base
M1370 must preserve M1154 lineage as previous public base if promotion occurs
M1370 must keep private holdout unused
M1370 must not train, run PPO, run new replay, or change actor inputs
M1370 must not claim source-rich extreme, level3 self-ID, high-fidelity, or paper-level evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run new replay or fresh evaluation
do not relax M1369 thresholds after seeing results
do not promote without explicitly naming claim boundaries
do not claim strong self-identification or source-rich extreme validation

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: decides whether the M1369 gate candidate should become the official public base before any PPO or private holdout
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public-base promotion audit only; no PPO, private holdout, paper-level, high-fidelity, source-rich extreme, or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if M1369 evidence is inconsistent or missing
stop if promotion would rely on private holdout or new unregistered evaluation
stop if claim boundaries cannot be stated clearly
stop if actor input contract evidence is ambiguous
fallback_plan: if evidence is accepted, promote M1362 alpha 0.1 as public base and route to post-promotion synthesis/readiness
if evidence is insufficient, route to targeted audit without changing public base
if lineage is ambiguous, route to lineage audit
if claim boundary is too broad, narrow the promotion claim and keep paper-level gates pending
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1369 classifies the candidate as promotion-audit ready

admission_evidence: M1369 six-surface public proof replay and source-diverse diagnostics pass
M1369 fresh public and moderate-OOD generalization pass
M1369 behavior and ablation retention pass
blocked_shortcuts: do not run additional gates inside the audit
allowed_updates: official current-status/public-base references if promotion is accepted
status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: next branch is selected without private holdout contamination
PPO remains blocked unless a later guarded PPO readiness design admits it

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: Public-base promotion does not prove anticipatory recurrent belief or history necessity beyond existing wrong-history and ablation diagnostics.
history_necessity_tests: M1370 may cite M1369 behavior ordering and proof replay retention only as level2 evidence
M1370 must leave L0/L1/L2/L3 and source-rich self-ID evidence for later branches
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If the audit rejects promotion, preserve the rejection reason and route to a named audit without changing public base.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, private-holdout, high-fidelity, real-vehicle, source-rich extreme, or paper-level claim

hypothesis: M1369 evidence is sufficient to promote M1362 alpha 0.1 as the official public base, while keeping paper-level and self-ID claims pending.
success_criteria: audit accepts or rejects public-base promotion explicitly
no training, PPO, new replay, new evaluation, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: audit overclaims private-holdout, source-rich, paper-level, or level3 self-ID evidence
training, PPO, private holdout, new replay, new evaluation, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1370 may promote M1362 alpha 0.1 as the public base only if it accepts the M1369 evidence and keeps private-holdout, source-rich, PPO, and self-ID claims out of scope.
